summary: Flat circular aluminum baseplate, 144 mm in diameter and 6 mm thick. Five identical cutouts with a quad-lobe counterbored pattern sit in the plate, one at the center and four arranged symmetrically around it. The plate also has many small through-holes and larger counterbored holes spread across the face. One product image shows it as a rotating platform on a gearbox hub, and another shows it as a base with rubber feet.

mountingSurfaces.description: Top flat face, used to mount the assembly. Counterbored holes let M4 screw heads sit below the surface.
Bottom flat face, used to rest on a table or floor, or to attach rubber feet or a hub.

notes: Only the 144 mm diameter and 6 mm thickness are stated. The part is centered on the origin, with its thickness along z. The individual hole diameters and positions are not printed in the images or the product data. Hole diameters, positions, and counterbore depths were left out rather than guessed, so the holes array is empty. The locations visible in the images are the central cutout and the four symmetric cutouts. The source data is marked as unverified, so the CAD hole pattern still needs the vendor's drawing.
